# Tomato blight

Late blight is caused by Phytophthora infestans and spreads fast in warm, wet weather.

## Symptoms

Brown patches appear on the lower leaves, then the stems darken and the fruit develops greasy bronze blotches.

## Treatment

Pull off and bin every infected leaf (never compost it), water at the base instead of overhead, and rotate the bed so solanaceous crops don't grow there for three years.
